create.name: Helsingin Astanga Joogakoulu
create.bio:
Helsingin Astanga Joogakoulu, the Ashtanga Yoga School of Helsinki, was founded in 1997 and describes itself as one of the oldest schools in Europe devoted to Ashtanga yoga. Its practice rooms are in a courtyard building on Annankatu in the Kamppi district of central Helsinki, and classes are taught in Finnish and English.

The school's backbone is Mysore-style practice, where each student moves through the Ashtanga sequence at their own pace with individual help from the teacher. Newcomers begin with an introductory course, then move on to follow-up courses and graded led classes before joining the Mysore room. Alongside Ashtanga the timetable includes gentler yoga for all, yin yoga and some live online classes.

Senior teachers Petri Räisänen and Juha Javanainen lead special events through the year. Over the turn of the year they run a Winter City Retreat in Helsinki that pairs morning Mysore practice with pranayama, meditation, chanting and talks on the spiritual side of yoga. Each July the school moves to Houtskär, an island in the archipelago of south-west Finland, for a summer retreat of up to three weeks with daily Mysore practice, yoga philosophy on the Yoga Sutras, pranayama and meditation, mostly vegan meals and an evening sauna by the sea; families are welcome and the classes are mainly in English.

courses.title: Winter City Retreat with Petri and Juha
courses.description: Six mornings of Mysore-style Ashtanga, led by Petri Räisänen together with Juha Javanainen, at the school's Annankatu studio, with late-morning pranayama, meditation and chanting and talks on yoga, mind and consciousness. Taught in English; days can be booked singly.
courses.price: Yoga 6 days and workshop 4 days: 286 € (reduced 259 €); Yoga and workshop 1 day: 89 € (reduced 79 €); Morning yoga drop-in: 41 € (reduced 37 €)

courses.title: Ashtanga Yoga Summer Retreat on Houtskär
courses.description: One to three weeks on an island in the southern Finnish archipelago: early-morning Mysore practice or a beginners' course, afternoon technique labs, pranayama and Yoga Sutra philosophy, mostly vegan meals and a sauna by the sea. Family friendly, taught mainly in English.
